edit.description: A `PreToolUse` hook envelope beside `session_start`'s `SessionStart` one: `hookSpecificOutput` with `hookEventName: "PreToolUse"` carrying the guard's rendered finding as `additionalContext`, capped by the existing `cap`. Cite the external fact (code.claude.com/docs/en/hooks, "Exit code 0", retrieved 2026-09-24) at the site: a hook's stderr on exit 0 reaches the debug log only, never the model.

Both `Warn` arms of `Command::Guard` — the manifest-findings branch (~:389) and the `GuardVerdict::Warn` branch (~:409) — stop `eprintln!`ing and print the PreToolUse envelope to stdout, still exiting 0. `Block` keeps stderr + exit 2 (the one exit code Claude Code does deliver stderr from); `Note` stays silent.

`run_guard_spawned_in` must let a caller see stdout. Reuse the house pattern `check_in`/`CheckRun` already sets — a combined stdout-then-stderr string — rather than a second capture helper or a tuple widening that respells ~50 destructurings across tests/install.rs and tests/cli.rs.

The guard's mode loop (~:545) asserts exit codes only. Add the warn-mode placement assertion: the finding rides `hookSpecificOutput.additionalContext` under `hookEventName: "PreToolUse"`, and `note` still emits nothing.

The three warn-mode arms (~:1667, ~:1843, ~:2149) assert the finding's text against the guard's second returned string; they must read the new placement, not stderr. The `note`-mode emptiness assertions stay as they are.

summary: The guard's `warn` mode prints to stderr and exits 0, so Claude never sees it — surface the finding in-band as PreToolUse `additionalContext`.

per.section: The placements and their enforcement modes

tests.asserts: under `warn` the guard exits 0 and its stdout is a PreToolUse `hookSpecificOutput` envelope whose `additionalContext` carries the finding; under `note` it emits nothing
the governed-locus, memory and manifest warn arms each read their finding out of the in-band envelope, and `block` still writes stderr with exit 2

acceptance: `cargo test` green with the new warn-placement assertions, which fail on the pre-fix tree; `cargo clippy --all-targets -- -D warnings` clean.
notes: Measured on Claude Code 2.1.281: a PreToolUse hook writing to stderr and exiting 0 left the token in the debug log, out of the model's context. warn is the default, so the default guard is invisible. 0060's PostToolUse edge is the same seam and the same `Warn` arms — the tick that derives it widens this entry, never a sibling. tests/install.rs overlaps INSTALL-LIFTS, held unpickable by `(hook-member-identity)`; serialize them when that fork resolves. scoped at b95d5e8f
